title: Mijnwerker ('De Bergwercker'), plate 75 of Het Menselyk Bedryf, Jan and Caspar Luyken
date: 1694 (Rijksmuseum; first edition of Het Menselyk Bedryf)
depicts: Small etching on a sheet with wide margin. Heading 'De Bergwercker.' and motto 'Hoe hoog van waarde, 't Is Stof der Aarden.', number 75. In the picture: a miner in a hooded smock sits resting in the foreground with a cup and bread, beside a wheelbarrow and a pick-axe with lumps of ore; behind him, at a rock face with a cave-like mine entrance, other miners work a large horizontal windlass (hoist) on a timber frame and push barrows; mountains and clouds behind. Below, a six-line Dutch verse ('Al leidt het diep verdeckt voor d'oogen ...'). Exactly period (1694, four years before Savery's patent); shows miners and mine-head hoisting, not water pumping. Picture panel only: approx x 0.09-0.90, y 0.157-0.707.
